lines.x: Low European gas inventories and disrupted Qatari LNG flows through the Strait of Hormuz have pushed Europe to bid up LNG cargoes, lifting benchmark prices across both Europe and Asia.
European countries have already withdrawn 11% of the natural gas injected into storage during the summer.
European Council President Antonio Costa proposed a €204 billion reduction in the EU's long-term budget, including a new tax on Big Tech companies.
The European Commission's flash consumer confidence indicator for the Eurozone rose by 1.0 point to -16.9 in November, defying analyst forecasts of a deterioration.
